contentText: First, the European Parliament calls on EU member states to officially designate the  Rapid Support Forces in Sudan a terrorist organisation. Then, Kenya's Rastafarian community waits with bated breath as the country's high court gears up to deliver a ruling on the legalisation of marijuana. And, Morocco is still reeling from a heartbreaking 2-nil defeat to France, ending the Atlas Lions' historic World Cup journey.
